text:
Landing at Kansai Airport with a Kyoto hotel?
The Haruka takes about 75–80 minutes, no change.
But there's one landing time
when the bus is the only smart choice 👇

👉 Guess which landing time, then check:
https://japanbystation.com/kansai-airport-to-kyoto

🚄 Option A: the JR Haruka
The last train leaves the airport at 22:16.
💴 Visitors pay ¥2,700 to Kyoto
with the HARUKA One-way Ticket,
if bought from 1 November 2026.

🚌 Option B: the limousine bus
💴 ¥2,800, about 85–90 minutes to Kyoto Station.
🧳 Suitcases go in the hold.
🌙 The last bus leaves Terminal 1 at 23:20,
more than an hour after the last Haruka.

🚃 Option C: ordinary trains via Osaka
Nankai, the subway, then Hankyu to Kawaramachi.
💴 About ¥1,670, about 1 hour 50 minutes.

💭 Our take
The Haruka, for most people.
Landing late, or a hotel south of Kyoto Station?
Take the bus.
Travelling light to Shijo? Take Hankyu.

👉 The free Kyoto Tower view from inside the station:
https://japanbystation.com/kansai-airport-to-kyoto

Which would you pick after a long flight:
train, bus or the cheap way?
